calculation_handling.description: Maximum combined width of all vehicle entrances through the front main wall is 6.0 m where the required minimum lot frontage is under 24.0 m; no dsl_target measures vehicle-entrance width.
calculation_handling.gaps: No vocab target for the combined width of vehicle entrances (driveway_width_m is a driveway, not an entrance).

units.disclosure: The 6.0 m limit on the combined width of vehicle entrances in the front main wall (lots with required frontage under 24.0 m) is not evaluated; there is no model target for entrance width.

calculation_handling.description: The lowest point of a vehicle entrance must be higher than the driveway centreline elevation at the street lot line; a grade comparison with no numeric limit.
calculation_handling.gaps: No elevation data for entrances or driveway centrelines; no vocab requirement for this obligation. The individual-private-driveway proviso applies to the townhouse arm only.

units.disclosure: The rule that a vehicle entrance must sit higher than the driveway centreline at the street lot line is not evaluated; no elevation data is held.

calculation_handling.description: Vehicle access to a parking space must be from the lane when the lot abuts a lane.

calculation_handling.description: Where the lot does not abut a lane, vehicle access must be from a flanking street that is not a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map.
calculation_handling.gaps: No vocab requirement for flanking-street access; the Policy Areas Overlay Map is not held; a negated lot condition (does not abut a lane) cannot be keyed.

units.disclosure: Access from a flanking street that is not a major street (lots not abutting a lane) is not evaluated; the Policy Areas Overlay Map is not held.

evidence.any: vehicle access to a parking space

calculation_handling.description: In all other cases vehicle access may be from the street on which the lot fronts.

10.5.80.40(1).explanation: In the Residential zones, on a lot with a detached house, semi-detached house, detached houseplex or semi-detached houseplex whose required minimum lot frontage is under 24.0 m, all vehicle entrances in the front main wall may total no more than 6.0 m wide.

10.5.80.40(2).explanation: In the Residential zones, the lowest point of a garage vehicle entrance must be higher than the driveway centreline where it meets the street lot line. This applies to detached and semi-detached houses and houseplexes, and to a townhouse unit with its own private driveway.

10.5.80.40(3).explanation: In the Residential zones, vehicle access to a parking space must come from the lane if the lot abuts one. If not, it must come from a flanking street that is not a major street on the Policy Areas Overlay Map. In all other cases it may come from the street the lot fronts.
